item.title: Google says it is rolling out Personal Intelligence for Gemini on Android Auto now and to cars with Google built-in in the coming months as an opt-in feature (Abner Li/9to5Google)
item.description:

Google says it is rolling out Personal Intelligence for Gemini on Android Auto now and to cars with Google built-in in the coming months as an opt-in feature  —  Google is beginning to roll out Personal Intelligence for Gemini on Android Auto and Android Automotive (cars with Google built-in).

item.title: Pigment, a French startup that makes AI-powered software to help businesses forecast finances, spin up slide decks, and more, raised $250M at a $2.3B valuation (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
item.description:

PHP development team plans to release updates tomorrow to address two vulnerabilities, each rated 9.2; security researchers at watchTowr say they are RCE flaws  —  The PHP security team is warning administrators to prepare for emergency security updates tomorrow to address two critical vulnerabilities …

item.title: Elon Musk says Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a possible merger and calls the possibility of a Tesla-SpaceX merger a "good idea" (Andrew J. Hawkins/The Verge)
item.description:
Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge:
Elon Musk says Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a possible merger and calls the possibility of a Tesla-SpaceX merger a “good idea”  —  Musk called the merger “a good idea,” though it cautioned it wasn't a guarantee.

Original (direct link): https://www.theverge.com/science/1014984/spacex-tesla-merger-elon-musk-special-committees

item.description:

Eight intermediate TLS certificates from eMudhra with private key sizes of just 3 to 8 bits were compromised; browser makers and major apps have blocked them  —  Security personnel around the world are on high alert Tuesday following the discovery of eight TLS certificates with private keys …

Original (direct link): https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/the-internet-goes-on-high-alert-after-discovery-of-8-compromised-tls-certs/

item.title: Super Micro reports preliminary Q1 revenues of $18.5B to $19.5B, vs. $15B est., and gross margins of 12% to 12.5%; SMCI jumps 11%+ after hours (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Dina Bass / Bloomberg:
Super Micro reports preliminary Q1 revenues of $18.5B to $19.5B, vs. $15B est., and gross margins of 12% to 12.5%; SMCI jumps 11%+ after hours  —  Super Micro Computer Inc. jumped in late trading after reporting preliminary quarterly results that topped analysts' estimates.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/super-micro-jumps-after-preliminary-results-top-estimates

item.title: SpaceX reports Q3 capex of $19.6B, up from $6.9B a year earlier, and Q3 connectivity revenue, which includes Starlink, up 69% YoY to $5.2B (Becky Peterson/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Becky Peterson / Wall Street Journal:
SpaceX reports Q3 capex of $19.6B, up from $6.9B a year earlier, and Q3 connectivity revenue, which includes Starlink, up 69% YoY to $5.2B  —  Artificial intelligence revenue surges around 830% while capital spending on data center build-out and developing new technology continues

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/business/earnings/spacex-spcx-q3-earnings-report-2026-stock-4138193d?st=eQFqUL&reflink=desktopwebshare_permalink

item.title: Report: Anthropic's draft S-1 shows it spent ~$9B on compute and infrastructure in H1, up from $2.3B a year earlier, and could spend $750B in the coming years (David Morris/Bloomberg)
item.description:

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/anthropic-could-spend-750-billion-on-computing-costs-wsj-says

item.title: Netflix says it expects FY 2026 ad revenue of ~$2.7B, under its ~$3B forecast, and its Q4 operating margin will be impacted due to costs associated with layoffs (Todd Spangler/Variety)
item.description:
Todd Spangler / Variety:
Netflix says it expects FY 2026 ad revenue of ~$2.7B, under its ~$3B forecast, and its Q4 operating margin will be impacted due to costs associated with layoffs  —  But the streamer faces an urgent need to refresh its queue: Revenue growth in the period slowed to its lowest rate in three years …

Original (direct link): https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/netflix-q3-2026-earnings-wall-street-layoffs-exec-firings-1236917438/

item.title: Sources: Elon Musk ordered Starshield slowdown in Ukraine and discussed it with Trump after the issue became public; some US officials say he acted unilaterally (Wall Street Journal)
item.description:

item.title: SpaceX reports Q3 revenue up 161% YoY to $14.58B, vs. $12.72B est., AI revenue up 830% to $7.56B, and AI operating income of $431M, up from a loss of $1.7B (Lora Kolodny/CNBC)
item.description:
Lora Kolodny / CNBC:
SpaceX reports Q3 revenue up 161% YoY to $14.58B, vs. $12.72B est., AI revenue up 830% to $7.56B, and AI operating income of $431M, up from a loss of $1.7B  —  SpaceX reported 161% revenue growth for the third quarter, driven by the company's artificial intelligence business and Starlink Subscriber growth.

Original (direct link): https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/20/spacex-spcx-earnings-live-updates-q3-2026html.html

item.title: Anthropic's IPO prospectus: H1 2026 revenue of $16.3B, ~20% from two customers, vs. $1.1B in H1 2025, and an $80.7B net loss driven by accounting charges (Anissa Gardizy/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Anissa Gardizy / Wall Street Journal:
Anthropic's IPO prospectus: H1 2026 revenue of $16.3B, ~20% from two customers, vs. $1.1B in H1 2025, and an $80.7B net loss driven by accounting charges  —  In a new draft prospectus viewed by the Journal, the AI giant disclosed an $80.7 billion net loss for the first half of 2026 and a long list of risk factors

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/anthropic-revenue-growth-ipo-accaf0f1?st=YKUo1r
